_about: Phase 4 scorecard v2 (POST HOC, see config/phase4_amendment.json): what Phase 4 can prove without a paid model call. Written 2026-11-22 before any scripted or live run existed. Model-quality items (grounded and safe live answers) are judged in Phase 6.

S1_tools_correct.means: all 8 database tools return exactly what a fresh run and independent SQL return

S2_agent_loop_proven.means: the loop handles tool calls, budget stops, refusals and limits correctly (fake-model tests)

S3_checkers_proven.means: the grounding and safety checkers accept good answers and catch planted bad ones

S4_cost_ledger_proven.means: cost comes from the API's token counts, matches an independent formula, and is estimated before any paid call

S5_replay_and_ci.means: recorded runs replay identically for free; tests and checks run in CI
